stories.headline: Anthropic in Talks to Buy Israeli Startup Decart for About $6 Billion
stories.key_takeaway: Anthropic is in early talks to buy Israeli efficiency-AI startup Decart for about $6 billion to cut its inference costs ahead of a record IPO.

pull_quote.text: Once systems can understand and operate within the physical world, the range of what becomes possible expands dramatically — from robotics and autonomous systems to entirely new forms of commerce and live experience.

stories.article_excerpt: Anthropic is in advanced talks to acquire Decart, a three-year-old Israeli startup that squeezes more speed out of AI chips.

stories.headline: AI Coding Startup Cognition in Talks to Raise at a $40 Billion-Plus Valuation
stories.key_takeaway: Cognition, maker of the Devin coding agent, is in early talks to raise at a $40 billion-plus valuation just three months after a $26 billion round, powered by a revenue run-rate approaching $1 billion.

pull_quote.text: We envision a world of software abundance where engineers become architects, solving the most challenging problems and focusing on their creative visions while tasking an army of autonomous agents to support them on everything else.

stories.article_excerpt: Cognition is in talks to raise at a $40 billion-plus valuation just three months after its $26 billion round.

stories.headline: Legal AI Startup Legora Seeks Funding at More Than a $10 Billion Valuation
stories.key_takeaway: Sweden's Legora is seeking to roughly double its valuation to more than $10 billion just four months after its last raise, fueled by surging revenue and an escalating legal-AI arms race with rival Harvey.

pull_quote.text: Foundation models are improving quickly, but the real value is in how they're applied.

stories.article_excerpt: Four months after a $5.6B valuation, Sweden's Legora is in talks to raise at more than $10B.

stories.headline: OpenAI-Backed Thrive Holdings Raises $2 Billion at a $12 Billion Valuation
stories.key_takeaway: Thrive Holdings raised over $2 billion at a $12 billion valuation to buy traditional service businesses and rebuild them around AI, betting the biggest returns lie in owning the firms that must adopt AI rather than the labs that build the models.

pull_quote.text: We think AI partnered with a lot of the experts and practitioners at these businesses can really help compress [regulatory bottlenecks], keep the safety standards high, but also be able to do it with less of a burden.

stories.article_excerpt: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings raised $2B at a $12B valuation to turn AI roll-ups of traditional service firms into a strategy.

stories.headline: Data Center Giant Vantage Weighs a $100 Billion IPO as the Compute Boom Reshapes Infrastructure
stories.key_takeaway: Vantage Data Centers is exploring a record ~$100 billion IPO or sale, a valuation that reframes AI data centers as high-growth infrastructure rather than sleepy real estate.
stories.article_excerpt: Vantage Data Centers, backed by Silver Lake and DigitalBridge, is weighing a record ~$100B IPO amid the AI compute boom.

stories.headline: Lenovo Posts Record $26.9 Billion Quarter as AI Revenue Jumps 60%
stories.key_takeaway: Lenovo's record $26.9B quarter, with AI revenue up 60% and its server unit's profit at an all-time high, is the clearest sign yet that AI spending is broadening beyond Nvidia and hyperscalers into PCs and enterprise hardware.

pull_quote.text: AI is emerging as a clear growth engine across every business group. Building on our leadership in PCs and Smart Devices, we are proud of our rapid emergence as a global leader in AI and Infrastructure.

stories.article_excerpt: Lenovo posts its strongest quarter ever as AI revenue jumps 60%, signaling the boom is broadening beyond the cloud giants.

stories.headline: SpaceXAI Releases Grok 4.6, Matching Top Frontier Benchmarks at Half the Price
stories.key_takeaway: Grok 4.6 ties GPT-5.6 Sol and trails Claude Opus 5 by two points on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index while costing more than 60 percent less, turning price-to-intelligence into xAI's core competitive bet.

pull_quote.text: It delivers frontier intelligence and is a significant improvement over Grok 4.5 at the same price.

stories.article_excerpt: SpaceXAI's Grok 4.6 ties GPT-5.6 Sol on the AA Intelligence Index at more than 60 percent lower cost.

stories.headline: Google Unveils the Pixel 11 With Tensor G6 and Proactive Gemini AI
stories.key_takeaway: Google's Pixel 11 series bets that proactive, agentic Gemini AI running on the new Tensor G6 chip, not incremental hardware, is now the real reason to upgrade a phone.

pull_quote.text: a totally new way to interact with a computer

stories.article_excerpt: Google's Pixel 11 keeps familiar hardware but wraps it in a proactive Gemini that no longer waits to be asked.

stories.headline: Nvidia's NeMo Switchyard Brings Dynamic Model Routing to Long-Running Agents
stories.key_takeaway: Nvidia's open-source NeMo Switchyard lets agents switch models mid-task to route each step to the cheapest capable model, with partner benchmarks claiming cost cuts of roughly 70% at a modest accuracy tradeoff.
stories.article_excerpt: Nvidia open-sourced NeMo Switchyard, letting agents switch models mid-task to route each step to the cheapest capable model.

stories.headline: Mirage Puts an AI News Network on the Air, Streaming Nonstop on X
stories.key_takeaway: Mirage launched a nonstop AI news network on X with fully synthetic anchors reading licensed stories, testing whether audiences will trust news delivered by a face that was never real.

pull_quote.text: just lowers the barrier for more people to be able to participate in creating content

stories.article_excerpt: On Aug. 12, Mirage launched a nonstop AI news network on X with synthetic anchors and no human on camera.

stories.headline: JEDI: A Joint-Embedding Diffusion World Model for Online Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
stories.key_takeaway: JEDI is the first online end-to-end latent diffusion world model, learning its latent space directly from a JEPA-style denoising objective to match pixel-diffusion RL performance at a fraction of the compute.
stories.article_excerpt: A new NUS paper, JEDI, lets a diffusion world model learn its own latent space end to end from the denoising loss.

stories.headline: PlayWorld Learns Robot World Models From Autonomous Play, and RL in the Simulator Transfers to the Real World
stories.key_takeaway: PlayWorld trains a robot world model entirely from autonomous self-play, and running reinforcement learning inside that learned simulator raised real-world manipulation success rates by 65 percent.
stories.article_excerpt: PlayWorld lets a robot teach itself by playing, trains a video world model on the results, and runs RL inside it.

stories.headline: 'Horizon Imagination' Makes On-Policy Rollouts in Diffusion World Models Far More Efficient
stories.key_takeaway: By denoising many future frames in parallel with a schedule that decouples denoising budget from horizon, Horizon Imagination sustains full control performance while roughly halving the compute cost of on-policy rollouts in diffusion world models.
stories.article_excerpt: Diffusion models draw the future in exquisite detail, but one denoising pass at a time. Horizon Imagination sketches many at once.

stories.headline: DeepMind's Demis Hassabis Pushes for an Independent AI Safety Oversight Body
stories.key_takeaway: Hassabis is privately lobbying U.S. officials and rival labs to create an industry-funded, government-overseen AI safety standards body, but questions of independence, self-regulation and cross-border enforcement remain unresolved.

pull_quote.text: a thoughtful framework overall and certainly a good starting point for discussions

stories.article_excerpt: Hassabis has stopped writing memos about AI governance and started lobbying the officials who could build it.

stories.headline: Microsoft Pulls Back in China While Keeping a Strategic AI Door Open
stories.key_takeaway: Microsoft has shut at least 15 China offices and joint ventures in five years but stays put to serve Chinese firms going global with Azure and Western AI, a strategy of controlled exposure amid tightening export controls.
stories.article_excerpt: Microsoft has spent five years dismantling much of its China footprint while keeping one AI-driven door open.

stories.headline: White House Unveils First Genesis Mission Grants in Its Flagship AI-for-Science Push
stories.key_takeaway: The administration's Genesis Mission awarded its first roughly 280 AI-for-science grants while a companion report and NSF budget clawbacks signaled a broader, contested push to redirect federal research toward AI.

pull_quote.text: Too much of our research enterprise has come to serve itself rather than the scientists within it

stories.article_excerpt: The White House chose a familiar frame for its most ambitious science bet in a generation: the Manhattan Project.
